title: Safety Alert: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: A pump went back into service after a seal change without a leak test, and the seal failed.

items.text: A transfer pump was restarted after a seal change with no leak test on the work order [EVD-0001]. The seal had been bought locally without a specification, and it leaked and caught fire [FND-0003].
Any site that restarts pumps after maintenance without a return-to-service checklist can repeat this [FND-0002].

items.lesson: If a joint is disturbed, test it before service: an untested joint can leak at the first restart.

items.text: Does every restart after seal work need a signed leak-test record?
Are pump seals bought to a written specification?

items.question: When did a pump last go back into service here without a test?
items.why: Shows whether the test is part of the job or depends on memory.

items.question: What would you do if the test rig was not available?
items.why: Shows whether people feel able to stop a restart.

items.text: Questions about this alert go to the site reliability lead.
